Thats more like it, mate. But you still have no activity on the forums. You need that activity here, because that's how you get integrated in the DREAM "family" and you get to know people better. In exchange they get to know you better, too, which is always good when you are trying to support the community by applying as an admin.


I know there is nearly no English community on this forums, which is why I guess one could ignore the fact, that this is your second post.


My suggestion for you would be:


Since your previous application is most likely getting rejected, you now are not allowed to apply again for 1 month. Use that month to integrate in the forums, make some new compadres and Bring out suggestions that could help the community and the server you like to play on.
Write threads with critique or suggestions how to make things better, that's the best way to be part of this big family.


I wish you best of luck with your next application!
